# `Length`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Length — the shared CSS length-unit spelling, as ONE language-level
SSOT.

`Ipe.Ui.Length` (layout intent) and `Ipe.Css.Length` (typography) are two
distinct surface types, deliberately not merged: a naive union pollutes each
(Ui would gain a meaningless `Rem`/`Ch`, Css a meaningless `Fill`/`Min`).
They share exactly the integer-magnitude units `Px`/`Vh`/`Vw`, whose CSS
`<n><unit>` spelling MUST be byte-identical across surfaces.

This module owns that spelling for the Ipê side — the language-level mirror
of the runtime carrier `ipe_runtime::length::CssUnit`, which owns the same
spelling for the native side. `Ipe.Css.lengthToString` folds its shared arms
through `toCss` here rather than re-deriving `String.fromInt n ++ "px"`, so
the shared spelling exists in exactly one place per language. The two
languages cannot import each other, so their byte-equivalence is asserted by
the `css_length_color_ssot` equivalence gate, never hand-synced.

The unit set is closed to the genuinely-shared units; a surface-specific
unit (`Ipe.Ui`'s `Fill`/`Content`, `Ipe.Css`'s `Rem`/`Em`/`Ch`/`Fr`) is
spelled by its own surface, never here.

## `Unit`

A CSS length unit whose spelling is shared across every Ipê surface.

Closed to the integer-magnitude units both `Ipe.Ui.Length` and
`Ipe.Css.Length` express. A surface-specific unit is not representable here,
so this type is the SSOT only for what is actually shared.

## `toCss`

```ipe
toCss : Int -> Unit -> String
```

`toCss n unit` — the one place a shared length is spelled for CSS: an
integer magnitude followed by the unit suffix (`toCss 16 Px` → `"16px"`).

Mirrors `ipe_runtime::length::CssUnit::css` byte-for-byte; the
`css_length_color_ssot` gate holds the two in lockstep.
